WITH consultation_events AS (
    SELECT consulta_id, cpf, timestamp_evento,
           detalhes->>'nome_extraido' AS nome_tjsp,
           NULLIF(detalhes->>'total_processos', '')::integer AS total_processos
    FROM process_tracking
    WHERE etapa = 'CONSULTA'
      AND evento = 'CONSULTA_REALIZADA'
      AND consulta_id IS NOT NULL
      AND cpf <> '00000000000'
), cpf_stats AS (
    SELECT cpf,
           COUNT(*) AS quantidade_consultas_cpf,
           MIN(timestamp_evento) AS primeira_consulta_cpf,
           MAX(timestamp_evento) AS ultima_consulta_cpf,
           (ARRAY_AGG(nome_tjsp ORDER BY timestamp_evento DESC))[1] AS nome_tracking,
           (ARRAY_AGG(total_processos ORDER BY timestamp_evento DESC))[1] AS total_tracking
    FROM consultation_events
    GROUP BY cpf
), ranked_real_consultas AS (
    SELECT ce.*,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY ce.cpf
               ORDER BY COALESCE(ce.timestamp_consulta, ce.created_at) DESC, ce.id DESC
           ) AS cpf_rank,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY ce.whatsapp_from
               ORDER BY COALESCE(ce.timestamp_consulta, ce.created_at) DESC, ce.id DESC
           ) AS phone_rank
    FROM consultas_esaj ce
    WHERE ce.cpf <> '00000000000'
), latest_session AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (whatsapp_from)
           whatsapp_from, current_state, email, state_updated_at
    FROM consultas_esaj
    WHERE cpf = '00000000000'
    ORDER BY whatsapp_from, state_updated_at DESC NULLS LAST,
             updated_at DESC NULLS LAST, id DESC
), payment_stats AS (
    SELECT cpf,
           BOOL_OR(evento = 'PAYMENT_APPROVED') AS tracking_paid,
           MAX(timestamp_evento) FILTER (WHERE evento = 'LINK_GERADO') AS link_gerado_em
    FROM process_tracking
    WHERE etapa = 'PAYMENT'
    GROUP BY cpf
), base AS (
    SELECT ce.id AS id_consulta,
           COALESCE(cs.ultima_consulta_cpf, ce.timestamp_consulta, ce.created_at) AS timestamp_consulta,
           COALESCE(NULLIF(ce.whatsapp_phone_number, ''), NULLIF(ce.whatsapp_from, '')) AS whatsapp,
           ce.cpf,
           COALESCE(NULLIF(ce.nome_requerente, ''), NULLIF(cs.nome_tracking, '')) AS nome_tjsp,
           COALESCE(ce.total_processos, cs.total_tracking, 0) AS total_processos,
           ce.processos,
           COALESCE(NULLIF(ce.email, ''), CASE WHEN ce.phone_rank = 1 THEN NULLIF(ls.email, '') END) AS email,
           ce.current_state,
           ce.mp_payment_status,
           ce.payment_link,
           ps.link_gerado_em,
           (COALESCE(ps.tracking_paid, FALSE)
             OR ce.mp_payment_status = 'approved'
             OR ce.current_state = 'PAYMENT_APPROVED') AS pago,
           CASE WHEN ce.phone_rank = 1 THEN ls.current_state END AS estado_sessao_atual,
           CASE WHEN ce.phone_rank = 1 THEN ls.email END AS email_sessao_atual,
           COALESCE(cs.quantidade_consultas_cpf, 1) AS quantidade_consultas_cpf,
           COALESCE(cs.primeira_consulta_cpf, ce.timestamp_consulta, ce.created_at) AS primeira_consulta_cpf,
           COALESCE(cs.ultima_consulta_cpf, ce.timestamp_consulta, ce.created_at) AS ultima_consulta_cpf
    FROM ranked_real_consultas ce
    LEFT JOIN cpf_stats cs ON cs.cpf = ce.cpf
    LEFT JOIN latest_session ls ON ls.whatsapp_from = ce.whatsapp_from
    LEFT JOIN payment_stats ps ON ps.cpf = ce.cpf
    WHERE ce.cpf_rank = 1
)
SELECT b.id_consulta AS "ID consulta",
       b.timestamp_consulta AS "Timestamp consulta",
       b.whatsapp AS "Número WhatsApp",
       b.cpf AS "CPF",
       b.nome_tjsp AS "Nome TJSP",
       b.total_processos AS "Total processos",
       proc.processos AS "Processos / valor principal",
       CASE
         WHEN b.pago THEN 'Pagou'
         WHEN b.link_gerado_em IS NOT NULL OR b.payment_link IS NOT NULL
           THEN 'Link gerado; sem pagamento aprovado'
         WHEN b.estado_sessao_atual = 'AWAITING_CODE'
              AND NULLIF(b.email_sessao_atual, '') IS NOT NULL
           THEN 'E-mail informado; código pendente (estado atual)'
         WHEN b.total_processos = 0 THEN 'Não tinha processos'
         WHEN b.estado_sessao_atual = 'AWAITING_CONFIRMATION'
           THEN 'Consultou; aguardando confirmação'
         ELSE 'Consultou; sem avanço registrado'
       END AS "Status classificado",
       b.email AS "E-mail",
       b.link_gerado_em AS "Link gerado em",
       GREATEST(0, FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - b.timestamp_consulta)) / 86400))::integer
         AS "Dias desde consulta",
       CASE
         WHEN b.pago THEN 'Estado/evento de pagamento aprovado'
         WHEN b.link_gerado_em IS NOT NULL THEN 'process_tracking PAYMENT/LINK_GERADO'
         WHEN b.total_processos = 0 THEN 'process_tracking CONSULTA_REALIZADA.total_processos'
         ELSE 'Estado atual da consulta/sessão; sem evento explícito de recusa'
       END AS "Evidência status",
       b.quantidade_consultas_cpf AS "Consultas CPF",
       b.primeira_consulta_cpf AS "Primeira consulta CPF",
       b.ultima_consulta_cpf AS "Última consulta CPF",
       CASE WHEN b.quantidade_consultas_cpf > 1
            THEN 'Consultou mesmo CPF de novo (' || b.quantidade_consultas_cpf || ' consultas)'
            ELSE 'Não'
       END AS "Repetição CPF"
FROM base b
LEFT JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT jsonb_agg(
        jsonb_build_object(
            'numero', per.numero,
            'data', per.data_processo,
            'valor_principal_bruto', per.valor_principal_bruto
        ) ORDER BY per.numero
    ) AS processos
    FROM (
        SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.item->>'numero')
               p.item->>'numero' AS numero,
               p.item->>'data' AS data_processo,
               edp.valor_principal_bruto
        FROM jsonb_array_elements(
            CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(b.processos->'lista') = 'array'
                 THEN b.processos->'lista'
                 ELSE '[]'::jsonb
            END
        ) AS p(item)
        LEFT JOIN esaj_detalhe_processos edp
          ON edp.cpf = b.cpf
         AND edp.numero_processo_cnj = p.item->>'numero'
        WHERE NULLIF(p.item->>'numero', '') IS NOT NULL
        ORDER BY p.item->>'numero', edp.timestamp_ingestao DESC NULLS LAST
    ) AS per
) AS proc ON TRUE
ORDER BY b.timestamp_consulta, b.cpf;
